name: Ichinose Houka
source: [url=/c37952]Kaoru's[/url] older cousin and childhood friend who is the president of the Fashion Design Club. Houka's hobby is cosplaying, and her dream is to become a fashion designer in the future. Despite keeping up a cool atittude in front of the others, Houka is actually quite shy.
